name: Kožichovice (Czechia)
description: Three vertical stripes of white, red and white in the ratio 1:1:1, with a yellow crozier with white sudarium in the red and a red rose with yellow centre and green sepals in each white stripe.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 15 December 1998 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
